svg.title: V-26. Safety mechanisms on the architecture (SysML v2 view mechanismsOnArchitecture)
svg.desc: Allocation view generated from the SysML v2 model, drawn at phone width. Top to bottom along the command path: the ML models and SoC software (QM), the SoC to MCU link, the safety layer, platform firmware and safety MCU (ASIL C), the harness and the vehicle CAN. Each element lists the safety mechanisms of WP-S-03 §6 it performs, coloured by diagnostic-coverage target, with the other elements that share the mechanism; between the elements, each interface IF-nn lists the mechanisms that implement a technical safety requirement the interface carries.
svg.text: V-26 · Safety mechanisms on the architecture

svg.text: Vehicle CAN · EPS, ECM / PCM, ABS / VSC, cluster
+E-nn: also performed by that element. Under an interface IF-nn: the mechanisms that implement a TSR the
interface carries, so a fault on that link is caught there.
